title: B's Class Pop Goes the Weasel

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher leads young children in a circle dance by participating directly with them, holding hands and moving to the music. Teachers walk alongside the children and guide them physically and verbally through the circle formation.

lesson_structure.note: Children and teachers holding hands in a circle dancing to Pop Goes the Weasel

steps_taught.name: Circle walk and crouch
steps_taught.description: Children walk in a circle holding hands and crouch down on 'pop goes the weasel'

what_works: Direct teacher participation and hand-holding helps guide young children
what_hinders: Large group of young children makes individual footing hard to see

evidence_segments.observation: Children and adults holding hands in a large circle on a rug
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact footwork details due to wide angle and group movement

extraction.distinctive_method: Group circle dance led directly by teachers holding hands with children in a classroom setting.
